newsitem.title: USA: Crescent Real Estate to raise $490 mln.
newsitem.headline: Crescent Real Estate to raise $490 mln.

text.p: Crescent Real Estate Equities Co said Tuesday it intends to raise about $490 million in a public offering of its common stock.

Crescent, one of the country's largest real estate investment trusts, said net proceeds of the offering will be used to partially fund the acquisition of more than $700 million of recently announced pending investments.
Separately, the company also said it has a commitment from the First National Bank of Boston to modify its existing $175 million unsecured credit facility.

Under the commitment, the credit facility will be increased to $350 million, the interest rate will be cut to 138 basis points over LIBOR from 185 basis points over LIBOR, and the maturity will be extended one year to April 2000, the company said.
It said the modification should be completed in April.
